review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, regression design self-review
review.decision: Require a recognized external protocol from strict Markdown decoding. Reject a permissive-only external address before it can reach either opener.
review.notes: The independent review reproduced a permissive-only protocol with a missing numeric entity terminator for HTTPS and mailto. This case includes a file-like external address and escaped slashes to cover both opener boundaries.

cases.description: Only strictly decoded protocols can launch a Markdown web or mail link
cases.setup: Mix literal schemes and fully terminated escaped protocol characters with missing terminators in the colon or slashes. Include a malformed URL ending in a file extension and an actual local file with legacy entity syntax.
cases.action: Inspect link affordances and activate the rendered links in the shared mobile renderer.
cases.expected: Only well-formed external links reach the native opener. Permissive-only protocol matches do not become local previews or external links. Explicit entity references preserve query separators and local evidence still uses the paired resolver interpretation.
